properties.title: East 25th Street Historic District was designated
properties.short_description: NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission announced designation of the East 25th Street Historic District in East Flatbush on November 17, 2020.
properties.explanation: A documented LPC action changed the listed preservation status of both sides of East 25th Street between Clarendon Road and Avenue D to historic district.

properties.title: Edge observation deck opened at Hudson Yards
properties.short_description: Hudson Yards opened Edge, the outdoor observation deck at 30 Hudson Yards, in March 2020.
properties.explanation: A new public observatory and high-level visitor space entered use at Hudson Yards.

properties.title: Gowanus Green affordable-housing project was announced
properties.short_description: NYC HPD announced on November 19, 2020 that Gowanus Green would be a 100 percent affordable-housing project with resilient public spaces.
properties.explanation: A documented HPD announcement recorded the project scope and affordable-housing commitment for the city-owned Gowanus Green site.

properties.title: Grand Concourse reconstruction Phase 3 was completed
properties.short_description: NYC DDC, DOT, and DEP announced on 12 August 2020 that Phase 3 of Grand Concourse reconstruction from 171st Street to 175th Street had been completed.
properties.explanation: A documented boulevard reconstruction phase completed roadway, curb, sidewalk, lighting, traffic-signal, median, pedestrian-ramp, drainage, and planting upgrades.

properties.title: Greenpoint Library and Environmental Education Center opened
properties.short_description: Brooklyn Public Library announced the new Greenpoint Library and Environmental Education Center opening to the public on 20 October 2020.
properties.explanation: A new library and environmental education building entered public service in Greenpoint.

properties.title: Harlem Hospital ExpressCare clinic opened
properties.short_description: NYC Health + Hospitals announced on February 14, 2020 that an ExpressCare clinic had opened at NYC Health + Hospitals/Harlem as the system's sixth ExpressCare clinic and second Manhattan location.
